title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai

This is not a role focused on training foundation models from scratch or building data pipelines only. You will work closely with Research, Product, and Data Engineering teams to take promising models and ideas from experimentation to reliable, production-ready systems.

What you’ll do

- Evaluate, compare and integrate open-source models for concrete product and customer use cases.

- Build and improve LLM-based applications.

- Extend and improve AI and ML models using inference optimization, evaluation, and fine-tuning where appropriate.

- Work with NLP, translation, speech-to-text / ASR, image and document understanding, and related applied AI models.

- Design evaluation frameworks covering model quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

- Take models from experimentation into production, including packaging, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

- Optimize inference performance and operational cost.

- Collaborate with Research and Product teams to turn prototypes and experiments into scalable product capabilities.

- Contribute to modern ML infrastructure and MLOps while remaining hands-on with models and model behaviour.

About you

- 4+ years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied AI, or a similar hands-on ML role.

- Strong Python skills and practical experience with modern ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, Transformers, and Hugging Face.

- Experience working with LLMs, NLP models, speech models, or other modern generative AI systems.

- Hands-on experience evaluating and experimenting with existing models rather than only building ML infrastructure.

- Experience with inference engines like vLLM or SGLang, and platforms like NVIDIA Triton or Ollama.

- Familiarity with fine-tuning, prompting, model evaluation, inference, and deployment.

- Working understanding of AI model encoding and quantization formats, and the tradeoffs thereof.

- Strong engineering mindset and ability to turn experiments into reliable, reproducible systems.

- Eligible to work in Germany; export-control screening required for certain programs.

Nice-to-haves

- Hands-on experience with model serving and production deployment, using technologies such as Kubernetes, KServe, NVIDIA Triton, and/or Ray Serve.

- Knowledge of inference optimization techniques, including batching, quantization, ONNX, or TensorRT.

- German language skills (B1+) and/or familiarity with defense or public safety datasets.

- Exposure to geospatial AI, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.

- Experience working in constrained or regulated environments with infrastructure, security, or deployment requirements.

- Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

- You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. 

- Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Bonus points if: 

- 

- You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.

- You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.

- You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.

- You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.

Benefits Overview :

- Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

- Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

- Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

- Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks: 

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Agicap 

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. 

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. 

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. 

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. 

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! 

Home page 

Customer Stories 

Our Values 

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap , la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte , dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics . On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique . Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.

👥L'équipe que tu rejoins 
Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data) . Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations .

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.

💪 Tes missions 

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

- Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.

- Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.

- Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).

- Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses. 

- Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille 

- Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.

- Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.

- Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.

- Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.

- L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.

- Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

⭐ Notre stack 

- GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker

- Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery

- Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary

- IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions

- Langages : Python, SQL, Docker

- IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche 

Indispensable

- 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production .

- SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).

- Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.

- Python de qualité , testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.

- Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.

- Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.

- Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble , et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.

- Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote .

- Anglais B2 minimum .

Un gros plus

- Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.

- Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

Un plus

- Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.

- Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).

- Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).

- Pipelines data en Change Data Capture .

- Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

🎁 Ce qu'on offre 

- Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.

- Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année.

- Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.

- CDI , forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.

- Full remote — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe.

- 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).

- Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).

- Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus.

⏳ Process de recrutement 

- Screening avec notre Senior Talent Acquisition — 45 min sur ton parcours et ta motivation.

- 1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h. 

- 2ème entretien technique avec Kévin (Team Lead DE) et Julien — test SQL + test d'architecture oral + discussion technique + cas IA — 2h .

Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège.

AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

title: Technical Operations Engineer (CDI)
description:
Askara est une start-up SaaS en forte croissance qui développe un logiciel basé sur l'intelligence artificielle et piloté à la voix pour les dentistes.

Notre mission : simplifier le quotidien des dentistes en automatisant leurs tâches administratives , de la dictée vocale à la rédaction de documents médicaux complexes.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 000 praticiens utilisent notre solution, nous avons généré plus de 400 000 documents , et nous traitons plusieurs dizaines de milliers d'heures d'audio chaque mois.

Nous avons une équipe qui écoute les besoins des praticiens et construit le produit. Il nous manque la personne dont le métier est de le faire tourner .

Vos missions

Nous recherchons un(e) Technical Operations Engineer (TechOps) , dont la mission tient en une phrase : Askara marche, de façon fiable et sûre .

Concrètement, vous prenez la responsabilité de tout ce qui fait qu'un produit livré reste un produit qui fonctionne : la sécurité , l' IT interne, la qualité et les tests , la réponse aux incidents .

Ce poste est une création . Aujourd'hui, ces sujets sont portés par le CTO, en parallèle du reste. Vous n'héritez donc pas d'une page blanche (ISO 27001 obtenue, EDR déployé, CI/CD en place, tests Playwright, monitoring Sentry, procédure d'incident formalisée) mais d'un périmètre réel, éclaté, qui n'a jamais eu de propriétaire à plein temps.

Vous serez le pivot entre :

- la tech 

- le support 

- la conformité 

- la direction 

Un mot d'honnêteté sur la nature du poste : c'est un rôle très opérationnel et très interne . On y écrit des procédures, mais surtout on les applique. On y rédige un plan de test, puis on le joue. On y documente une politique d'accès, puis on va révoquer les comptes un par un. Si vous cherchez un poste de méthodologie pure, ce n'est pas celui-là. Si vous aimez que les choses soient carrées et que ça se voie, c'est exactement celui-là.

🧪 Qualité produit et tests 

(environ 40% du temps)

- Prendre la stratégie de test de bout en bout : plans de test, tests automatisés (Playwright), smoke tests, tests de non-régression

- Définir les critères de sortie d'une release : ce qui bloque un déploiement, ce qui ne le bloque pas

- Jouer la QA sur les parcours critiques avant chaque livraison web, desktop et mobile

🚨 Fiabilité et incidents 

(environ 30% du temps)

- Faire vivre la procédure d'incidents : niveaux de gravité, playbooks, status page, communication client

- Être Incident Lead sur les cas sérieux, et garantir que l'information circule vite et juste

- Animer les post-mortems sans recherche de coupable, et surtout s'assurer que les actions correctives sont livrées 

- Entretenir le monitoring et l'alerting 

🔐 Cybersécurité opérationnelle 

(environ 20% du temps)

- Faire vivre au quotidien notre dispositif de sécurité : EDR, MFA, gestion des vulnérabilités, durcissement des postes 

- Piloter les revues d'accès périodiques et en produire les preuves

- Organiser la sensibilisation de l'équipe : campagnes de phishing, rappels, formation à l'arrivée

🖥️ IT interne et parc 

(environ 10% du temps)

- Gérer le parc de postes (macOS et Windows) et de téléphones : achat, préparation, chiffrement, mises à jour, inventaire, remplacement

- Industrialiser l' onboarding et l'offboarding : matériel prêt le jour J, accès ouverts au bon niveau, tout coupé et récupéré au départ

- Administrer les comptes et les accès sur l'ensemble de nos outils : SSO, MFA, gestionnaire de mots de passe, droits par rôle

🛠️ Environnement 

- Cloud : AWS, Terraform

- Produit : application web (React), API (PHP / Symfony), Electron (Windows / macOS)

- Tests : Playwright, CI GitHub

- Monitoring : Sentry, UptimeRobot

- Data / BI : Metabase, SQL

- Suivi et doc : Linear, Notion, Slack

- Support : Intercom

- IA : Claude, agents et automatisations internes (MCP, scripts)

- Conformité : ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS, RGPD

👉 Vous n'avez pas besoin de savoir développer une feature, mais vous devez être capable de lire du code, comprendre une architecture et débugger sans dépendre de quelqu'un . Sans ça, le poste devient de la coordination, et ce n'est pas ce qu'on cherche.

Vos compétences

- Profil polyvalent et autonome , qui aime prendre un sujet en friche et le rendre carré

- Une expérience en IT / sysadmin, QA, DevOps, support technique 

- Solide sur au moins deux de ces axes, curieux(se) sur les autres : 

- IT interne et sécurité : gestion de parc, comptes et accès, bonnes pratiques

- qualité et tests : plans de test, automatisation, non-régression

- fiabilité : monitoring, incidents, diagnostic

- À l'aise avec l' IA comme outil de travail : vous l'utilisez déjà tous les jours et vous avez envie d'aller plus loin que le chat

- Capable de dire non à une release, et de l'expliquer sans braquer l'équipe

- Sang-froid en situation d'incident, et goût pour le concret : on mesure ce poste à ce qui est en place, pas à ce qui est prévu

- Bonus : expérience en santé numérique, en environnement audité (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS), ou en application desktop distribuée

Avantages

- CDI basé à Strasbourg, ouvert au remote (hybride idéal)

- Rémunération : 45 à 55k€ selon expérience

- Mutuelle prise en charge à 100% 

- Matériel haut de gamme fourni (MacBook ou Windows au choix)

- Poste transverse, rattaché à la direction technique, avec une vraie autonomie et une exposition directe à la direction

Ce poste est volontairement large, et il est appelé à grandir avec l'entreprise. Selon vos appétences :

- Responsable sécurité opérationnelle (RSSI opérationnel) 

- Directeur / Directrice des opérations , sur un périmètre élargi au-delà de la tech

You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Responsibilities

Deliver

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Technical Competencies

About the Role 

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey 

- During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

- Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

- After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves.

- Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively.

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality.

- Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain.

- Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

- Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve.

- Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers.

- Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications.

What You Bring 

- Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications.

- AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space.

- E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright.

- API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services.

- Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail.

- Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus.

- Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience.

- Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus.

What We Offer 

- Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland

- A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

- Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

- 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

- Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
description:
About Enode 

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

- 
Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

- 
Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

- 
Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

- 
Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

- 
Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

- 
Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

- 
Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

- 
Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: 

- 
Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

- 
AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

- 
Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

- 
Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

- 
Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

- 
Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

- 
A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

- 
Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

- 
Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

- 
Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

- 
On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

- 
Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

- 
A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

- 
Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

- 
Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

- 
Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

- 
Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

- 
Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

- 
Flexible, human-first culture.

- 
Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

- 
Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

- 
Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

- At least 3 years’ experience of commercial software development, solving different kinds of technical problems

- Experience with reactive programming in native mobile platforms

- Willingness and ability to take on new technologies

- Ability to break down complex problems into simple solutions

- High quality verbal and written communication skills

- Sense of ownership and pride in your work.

What We Offer 

- Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses

- “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.

- Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.

- Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.

- Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.

- Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.

- Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.

- Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.

- Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

- Generous referral bonuses. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Execution is our edge

We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description:
The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.

Tasks

Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline 

- Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.

- Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units.

- Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.

- Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

Data Infrastructure & Accessibility 

- Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.

- Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.

- Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.

- Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.

- Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

Data Quality & Analysis Support 

- Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.

- Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database.

- Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline.

- Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews.

- Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations.

- Support custom querying of processed datasets.

Requirements

Education & Experience 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

- 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred).

- Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines.

Technical & Domain Expertise 

1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture

- Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes).

- Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures.

2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development

- Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy).

- Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines.

- Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets.

3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing

- Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes.

- Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling).

Soft Skills & Work Style 

- Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams.

- Detail-oriented mindset: Uncompromising rigor regarding calibration metadata, unit conversions, and data accuracy.

- Adaptability: Drive to continuously improve data infrastructure as aircraft sensor counts, test frequencies, and analytical needs expand.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications 

- Knowledge of standard FAA / EASA flight test instrumentation requirements or military flight test standards (e.g. IRIG 106).

- Familiarity with dashboarding tools (e.g., Grafana) for rapid post-flight previews and real-time telemetry display.

- Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for internal engineering tool distribution.

- Direct experience with DAQ systems and digital bus protocols (CAN bus, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, PCM).

- Familiarity with binary flight data formats (e.g., IRIG 106 Chapter 10/11, MDF/MF4, HDF5, Parquet, or custom binary loggers).

- Experience with performing on-aircraft hardware troubleshooting (e.g., tracking down ground loops, signal noise, dropouts, or faulty scaling).

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Industrialization & Production
description:
Sunflower Labs is an internationally operating company providing a fully autonomous, AI-powered drone security system built to protect commercial, industrial, and residential properties. Security that flies ahead of every threat.

About the Role 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production.

You will take ownership of released product data and turn it into stable, documented, and efficient production processes. This includes DFM/DFA review, production readiness, assembly instructions and SOPs, tooling and test-process support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking you, a professional with a strong foundation in manufacturing electronic or electromechanical products, hands-on technical troubleshooting, and practical programming or scripting used in production or test environments. Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or similarly complex hardware is a plus.

Your Responsibilities

R&D to Production / Industrialization : 

- Own the transfer of released products, revisions, BOMs, drawings, specifications, and technical data from R&D into production.

- Perform DFM/DFA reviews and identify issues affecting manufacturability, assembly, testing, quality, cost, or cycle time.

- Provide structured manufacturing feedback to mechanical and electrical teams.

- Define production readiness and ensure engineering changes are correctly implemented on the production floor.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transition prototypes into repeatable production.

Production Documentation & Daily Support : 

- Create, approve, and continuously maintain assembly instructions, SOPs, test instructions, inspection instructions, and rework procedures.

- Ensure production documentation always matches the latest released product revision.

- Provide day-to-day technical support to technicians and remove process or tooling-related production blockers.

- Troubleshoot assembly, test, fixture, tooling, and configuration issues and drive root-cause resolution.

- Work with R&D when production issues require design, software, test, or documentation changes.

Tooling, Lean & Continuous Improvement : 

- Develop, improve, and maintain production fixtures, jigs, test setups, tools, and supporting scripts.

- Improve assembly sequence, workstation layout, standard work, material flow, and production methods.

- Reduce rework, waiting time, manual workarounds, process variation, and cycle time.

- Apply Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S, standard work, visual management, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

- Several years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, NPI, or a similar role.

- Practical experience manufacturing and troubleshooting electronic or electromechanical products.

- Strong understanding of assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, testing, and manufacturing documentation.

- Ability to independently review drawings, tolerances, BOMs, specifications, and released engineering data.

- Practical knowledge of DFM/DFA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem solving.

- Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit.

- Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation.

- Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness.

- Good spoken and written English.

- EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to have : 

- Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products.

- Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems.

- Experience designing production fixtures, jigs, or test equipment.

- Experience with FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Lean, 5S, or Kaizen.

- Experience with ERP/MRP or PLM systems such as Odoo, Aligni, or similar tools.

- Basic German.

Benefits

- Flexibility to work from home when tasks allow, without fixed weekly work-from-home days.

- Comprehensive training on products and production procedures.

- Hands-on experience with advanced drone and robotics technology.

- On-site parking, occasional team lunches, and team events.

title: Senior AI Engineer

We are optimally positioned to capitalise on strong global growth trends driven by digital adoption and regulatory expansion across lottery and iGaming markets.

Well, what about the team? 

Join our AI Transformation team to create new capabilities and rethink how teams across Product and Technology work. Our programme aims to help teams ship faster, improve quality, reduce the effort and cost of delivery, build products that strengthen our competitive position, and develop our people’s skills. We turn promising ideas into working products and practices that teams can adopt and reuse across the business.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be empowered to identify opportunities, propose ideas and build new products, tools and ways of working. You will take ownership of your own initiatives, from a clear hypothesis and agreed success measures through experimentation, production delivery and learning. Alongside this, you will work with engineering teams to turn their prototypes into reliable production products, own shared transformation tooling, and showcase new approaches through demos, tech talks, workshops and pairing. This role combines the creativity to see what could be different with the engineering judgement and drive to make it happen.

So, what will you be doing? 

- Originate and build new capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities across Product and Technology, turn them into practical proposals, and build products, internal tools, automations and agents that create value. Own selected initiatives from discovery through delivery, working with stakeholders to connect each idea to a clear programme outcome.

- Run experiments that lead to decisions: State the opportunity and hypothesis, then agree the success measure and threshold before building. Create the smallest useful experiment, use a feature flag or controlled rollout where appropriate, and measure against a control or baseline at an agreed review date. Use the evidence to scale, change or stop the work.

- Take prototypes into production: Deliver your own successful experiments and partner with engineering teams to productionise theirs. Resolve architecture, integration, testing, security and operational gaps, agree production-readiness criteria, and work through release and handover with the teams that will own and operate the resulting products.

- Improve how teams build software: Redesign planning, development, testing, review and delivery around the capabilities of AI. Build and trial approaches such as specification-driven development and agent-assisted workflows, then turn successful work into reusable skills, reference implementations, connectors and engineering patterns that teams can adapt.

- Own shared transformation tooling: Build and maintain the programme’s shared applications, APIs, integrations and analytics on AWS, including the Radar and Tracker and connections to engineering and collaboration systems. Keep these services reliable, maintainable and useful to activity owners and programme leaders.

- Champion practical AI engineering: Showcase emerging approaches and techniques through regular demos, tech talks, workshops, pairing and clear written guides. Share working examples, explain trade-offs and limitations, and turn successful experiments into practices that other teams can use.

- Evaluate tools and approaches: Keep up with developments in AI engineering, test them against real team needs, and recommend adoption based on evidence. Consider quality, cost, security and portability, helping teams retain flexibility as tools, models and pricing change.

- Embed quality and responsible use: Work with Platform, SRE, Cyber and governance colleagues to build evaluation, observability, access controls and appropriate human oversight into AI-enabled services and workflows. Help teams understand failure modes and make support, recovery and ownership arrangements clear.

- Develop capability in others: Mentor graduate and less experienced engineers, and work with learning and enablement colleagues to address practical skills gaps. Build teams’ confidence and ability to maintain what they adopt.

And what will you need? 

- Software engineering and delivery: Strong Python or TypeScript skills and experience taking prototypes into production, including APIs, cloud deployment (preferably AWS), automated testing, CI/CD and observability.

- Practical AI engineering: Experience building LLM applications, agents or automations, using AI coding tools effectively, and improving results through evals and error analysis. Familiarity with context, reusable skills and integrations through APIs or MCP.

- Initiative and product judgement: Evidence of spotting opportunities, creating useful solutions without a fully defined brief, and owning delivery from idea to outcome.

- Experimentation and evaluation: Ability to define hypotheses and success measures before building, run focused experiments against a baseline or control, and use evidence to decide what happens next.

- Sound engineering judgement: Ability to balance quality, reliability, security and cost, evaluate AI behaviour, and choose maintainable solutions with appropriate data access and human oversight.

- Technical evangelism and collaboration: Clear communication through demos, tech talks, workshops and written guides. Experience partnering with teams, mentoring engineers and helping others adopt effective practices.

What benefits will you get? 

- 25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance.

- Health insurance.

- Volunteering days.

title: Principal Applied Research Engineer
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The opportunity

At Synthesia we really care about video generation, especially about human centric avatar video generation. This led us to release models such as EXPRESS-Video , and soon our latest video model - these are the best avatar video models in the world, and we are committed to continuing and double down our efforts in leading that area. Our goal is to get to human centric video models that can generate arbitrary long videos at high resolution with arbitrary actions and events. That means continuously training large generative video models from scratch with the proprietary data pipelines and compute infrastructure to support it at scale. We are looking for a technical leader who owns the full stack end-to-end, someone who bridges pre-training and post-training, sets long-term direction alongside research leadership, and is personally present at the hardest parts of the work. If building foundation model capability from the ground up at a company genuinely committed to leading the field sounds like the right next challenge, this role was written for you.

About the role

Synthesia's video generation capability is core to everything we ship. It involves roughly 15 people working daily across pre-training and post-training stages, and the complexity of coordinating across those stages, at the scale of compute and data we now operate, requires a different kind of technical leadership.

We're looking for a Principal Research Engineer (L7) to own the full technical stack for offline video generation. This is a senior individual contributor position with outsized scope and influence. You'll partner directly with research leadership and team leads to define long-term strategy, resolve the hardest cross-cutting technical problems, and raise the bar for how quickly research reaches product.

The person we're looking for has trained large generative models from scratch, not supervised it from a distance, but done it, debugged it, and shipped it. More than that, they're driven by a genuine ambition to push what's possible in video generation, and they care deeply about seeing that work land in product and reach users.

What you'll do 

- 
Own the end-to-end technical direction for offline video generation, spanning pre-training and post-training, resolving the artificial boundary between those two stages in service of shipping better models faster.

- 
Partner with research leadership and team leads to define a unified long-term roadmap, broken into achievable objectives, and drive execution against it.

- 
Identify the most critical technical gaps across the video generation pipeline and jump in to unblock them, whether that means architectural decisions, training stability, post-training alignment, or cross-team coordination.

- 
Increase the velocity at which research ships to product: accelerate problem-solving, improve research-to-production handoffs, and increase visibility of research output in partnership with PMs.

- 
Coach and elevate more junior researchers and engineers toward senior technical thinking and execution.

- 
Help shape team structure and refine processes to enable high-velocity, cohesive execution across research.

You'll thrive in this role if you have 

- 
A proven track record training large-scale video generation models from scratch, across multiple nodes, at the scale of millions of hours of data.

- 
Deep experience with post-training techniques at scale: RLHF, GRPO, DPO, and the judgment to know when and how to apply them.

- 
A proven track record data quality and you are not reluctant to question it.

- 
The ability to think strategically about multi-year research direction and execute hands-on at the frontier of what the team is building.

- 
Strong cross-functional influence: you shape how teams work together without needing positional authority to do it.

- 
A leadership style grounded in technical involvement. You lead by example, inspire through craft, and communicate with clarity.

- 
Genuine hunger to unlock new capabilities and an obsession with shipping. You're not satisfied by research that stays in a notebook. You want it in the hands of users.

Particularly relevant experience 

- 
Having owned a major model generation or capability jump end-to-end, from training runs through to product deployment.

- 
Working across both pre-training and post-training stages on the same model family, with direct accountability for the outcomes of both.

- 
Experience operating at scale: large distributed training runs, significant compute budgets, and multi-million hour data pipelines.

- 
Applying alignment and fine-tuning techniques in a video or multimodal context, not just text.

- 
Experience with human feedback pipelines applied to generative video or audio.

- 
Leading or significantly influencing the technical direction of a research team while remaining hands-on.

Dealbreakers 

We will not be a good fit if you prefer to lead without staying technically involved, or if clear and direct communication across research and product isn't one of your strengths. This role requires presence at the frontier of the work, not above it. And if shipping doesn't excite you as much as the research itself, this probably isn't the right role.

- Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities 

- Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

- Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

- Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

- Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

- Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring 

- 8+ years in IT , spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

- 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams , including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

- Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

- Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

- Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

- Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience , with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

- Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

- Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

Why Join Hippocratic AI 

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts whoâve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building worldâchanging technologies â ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

title: Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %
description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Concordia AG suchen wir einen Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 % 

Darum CONCORDIA 

Als Expertin für Gesundheit setzt sich die CONCORDIA für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich Mitarbeitende wohlfühlen und verwirklichen können. Es ist geprägt von abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, vielseitigen Teams und einem familiären Umgang. Zudem motivieren wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, sich weiterzuentwickeln und voranzukommen. Menschen, die Spass an der Arbeit haben und beruflich vorwärtskommen wollen, finden bei uns, was sie suchen: Jobs, die zu 100 % gesund sind.

Deine Vorteile 

Ausgezeichnet von den Mitarbeitenden 

Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 % 

Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Das erwartet dich 

- Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen Betrieb, das Engineering und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Oracle- und PostgreSQL-Datenbankplattform sowohl im Daily Business als auch in Projekten und Releases.
- Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbank- und Data-Warehouse-Plattformen, bei der Migration von Oracle nach PostgreSQL und beim Ausbau unserer Datenbankplattformen in der Azure Cloud.
- Du unterstützt das Team bei der Automatisierung, Performance-Analyse, Scripting, Monitoring und Logging.
- Infrastructure as Code ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise: Du entwickelst unsere Automatisierung und Infrastruktur-Standards aktiv weiter. Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.
- Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres Data Warehouse mit GoldenGate und DataHub und trägst dazu bei, manuelle Prozesse weiter zu automatisieren.
- Austausch und Weiterentwicklung sind uns wichtig: Du hast regelmässig die Möglichkeit, User Groups und Hersteller-Events zu besuchen.
- Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen.
- Wir sprechen CH-Mundart & Deutsch und sind mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Büro Luzern.
- Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen.
Das bringst du mit 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken.
- Begeisterung für moderne Plattform- und Cloud-Technologien.
- Erfahrung in der Automatisierung (z. B. Bash, Python, Ansible) und Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern.
- Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch.
- Analytisches Denken, konzeptionelle Stärke und eine lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise.
- Informatikausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Firmensprache) sowie die Fähigkeit, englische Dokumentationen sicher zu verstehen.
Nice to have / Dein Entwicklungspotenzial 

- Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und deklarativen Systemen.
- Automatisierung mit Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Actions oder Chef.
- Infrastruktur-Provisionierung mit Terraform (On-Prem & Azure).
- Arbeitszeit: Du hast eine 41-Stunden-Woche und kannst Teilzeit oder flexibel arbeiten. Für ausgewählte Tätigkeiten kannst du regelmässig von zu Hause aus arbeiten.
- Familienfreundlich: Voller Lohn während 14 Mutterschaftswochen. Zusatzbeiträge zu Kinder- und Ausbildungszulagen. Bis zu 90 % Kostenübernahme für die Fremdbetreuung deiner Kinder.
- Aus- und Weiterbildung: Die CONCORDIA unterstützt interne und externe Weiterbildungen. Bei deiner Karriereplanung begleiten wir dich individuell.
- Pensionskasse: Wir bieten dir eine äusserst attraktive, sichere Pensionskasse mit überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberbeiträgen und grosszügigen Leistungen.
- Wertschätzung: In der CONCORDIA-Familie erlebst du Wertschätzung und Teamgeist.
- Versicherungen: Die CONCORDIA übernimmt die Lohnabzüge für Lohnausfallversicherungen (Krankheit und Unfall) und versichert dich grosszügig.
Bereits 2016 und 2018 brillierte die CONCORDIA beim Swiss Arbeitgeber Award mit hervorragenden Ergebnissen. Im Jahr 2020 holten wir uns dann sogar den ersten Platz in der Kategorie für grosse Unternehmen mit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeitenden und im Jahr 2022 wurden wir mit dem zweiten Platz ausgezeichnet. Auch im Jahr 2025 dürfen wir mit gutem Recht festhalten, dass wir zu den allerbesten Arbeitgeberinnen der Schweiz gehören.
